rationale: AI review of all registered300 Y365-433 planes and 18 representative orthogonal planes supports filling omitted lumen margins along the outer and inferior right lateral ventricular horn. The layered hippocampal tissue and bulk frond-like intraluminal tissue remain outside the candidate. All nine broad locator figures were also visually inspected. Only previously unlabelled cells are added; no other structure label is overwritten.
limitation: Not expert review or complete ventricular segmentation. The threshold locator reaches lateral and posterior crop faces. The adopted candidate scope excludes crop-touching cells and requires at least 50% finite-volume support; this is not anatomical proof by itself. Existing labels 18 and 22 with locator overlap remain unchanged. Native100 was not reviewed anew. Integration verification recorded separately; not public deployment.
